run_generate_images: run the script to generate images using a pre-trained IC-GAN or CC-IC-GAN model with instance conditioning
run_get_data: run get_data to load k-means instance features and image transforms from a stored dataset
run_get_model: run get_model to load a pre-trained BigGAN or StyleGAN2 generator from experiment config
run_get_conditionings: run get_conditionings to prepare noise vectors, instance features, and class labels for generation
run_main: run main to generate a grid of conditioned images and save as a high-resolution PNG figure
